outline.subject: The New South Wales C38 class locomotive is a type of steam locomotive built for express passenger services.

sections.title: New South Wales C38 class locomotive
sections.covers: This section introduces the C38 class steam locomotive and its role in hauling express passenger services.

sections.title: Design
sections.covers: This section describes the development and technical specifications of the locomotive design.

sections.title: History
